prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `sum_geometric(first, ratio, terms)` in src/lib.rs, the finite geometric series `first * (1 - ratio^terms) / (1 - ratio)`. When `ratio == 1` return `first * terms`. `terms == 0` returns 0. Return `None` when `first` or `ratio` is not finite. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
